out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Linens & Napkins, Proper Use
violations.observation: Linens (i.e. napkins, aprons, towels, table cloths) found used in direct contact with the following food item(s): Uncooked spring rolls in the 2DR FT cooler were being covered with a clean sanitizer towel.
violations.corrective_action: Linens may not be used in contact with food unless they are used to line a container for the service of foods and the linens are replaced each time the container is refilled for a new consumer. BY NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION, PLEASE MAKE SURE TO REMOVE ALL CLEAN SANITIZER TOWLES OFF OF FOODS. PLEASE MAKE SURE THERE IS NO DIRECT CONTACT FROM THE TOWEL TO THE FOOD ITEMS.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: multiple ingredients on cart next to stove were not labeled after being taken out of their original container. Also large storage containers of ingredients in the dry stock area, did not have a label on them either.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL FOODS TAKEN OUT OF THEIR ORIGINAL CONTAINER NEED TO BE LABELED. PIC SAID THEY WILL HAVE EVERYTHING LABELED BY TIME OF NEXT INSPECTION.
